articles.summary: Eliminate gas friction on Solana. Use ZeroDev’s Solana paymaster to sponsor transactions for Phantom, multisigs, and PDAs. Build for velocity and scale. ZeroDev’s Solana Gas Sponsorship allows Solana-based applications to sponsor transaction fees for users. It works across traditional wallets like Phantom, multisigs, and Program Derived Addresses (PDAs). By removing the requirement for users to hold SOL for gas, developers can eliminate onboarding friction and significantly improve user retention.
articles.title: Solana Gas Sponsorship: ZeroDev Brings Seamless UX to the SVM

articles.summary: Build once, deploy everywhere. Discover the ZeroDev Omni SDK—a high-performance, Zig-based core for native smart accounts in Swift, Go, Rust, and more. The ZeroDev Omni SDK is a cross-platform ERC-4337 smart account SDK built in Zig. It enables developers to implement account abstraction features like gas sponsorship and native mobile signing across Swift, Go, Rust, Kotlin, and Python, ensuring a unified developer experience across web, mobile, and backend.
articles.title: Build Once, Deploy Everywhere: Introducing the ZeroDev Omni SDK
